title: Unified Reliability Initiative Hub with Auto Rollups
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a single pane-of-glass in the Redwood Console that tracks reliability initiatives across product, SRE, and engineering teams. The hub will centralize SLI targets, current SLI values, error budget burn rates, owning team, remediation playbooks, and links to active mitigations. It should support automated rollups (daily and weekly) of error-budget consumption, surface regression trends tied to deployment rollouts, and auto-create follow-up tasks when burn thresholds are crossed. Scope: Console UI + API rollup worker + Linear integrations for auto-created mitigation tasks. Out of scope for this ticket: deep analytics engine for long-tail incident forensics (will be a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Console view shows all active reliability initiatives with SLI target, 30d SLI, current error budget %, and last updated timestamp
Automatic daily rollup job computes per-initiative error budget burn and stores snapshot accessible via Console and API
Alert/automation triggers at 50% and 80% burn thresholds and auto-creates Linear sub-issues assigned to owning team with templated remediation steps
Owners can link a runbook or GitHub PR to an initiative and the Console displays the top-level mitigation link
UI supports filtering by org, model, region, and priority and persists user filter preferences
Design sign-off completed and engineering prototype demonstrates hourly rollup without exceeding existing metrics API quotas
tasks: Design: wireframes for initiative list, detail, and modal for creating automation thresholds (owner: DES-204)
Backend: implement rollup worker that ingests SLI timeseries and computes burn (owner: ENG-4123)
API: add endpoints for initiative CRUD and rollup snapshots (owner: ENG-4187)
Console: list + detail pages and alert subscription controls (owner: Console-UI)
Automation: Linear integration to create templated mitigation issues and link back to initiative
QA: SLI synthetic tests to validate rollup math across edge cases (no-data windows, partial buckets)
risks: Metrics ingest rate could exceed current telemetry quotas; mitigation: batch and backfill with controlled rate and exponential backoff
False positives from transient blips could trigger noisy automations; mitigation: require sustained burn over a 6-hour window before auto-create
Ownership disputes across teams on what constitutes an "initiative"; mitigation: taxonomy doc and mandatory owner field
Latency of rollups could misalign with on-call workflows if rollups run only daily; mitigation: support hourly rollups for critical initiatives
decisions: Rollup cadence: default daily snapshots with optional hourly mode for initiatives flagged as 'critical'
Auto-create policy: create mitigation issues only when burn rate >80% sustained for 6 hours; for 50% create a 'watch' Slack ping only
Data retention: keep 90 days of daily snapshots in Console and 365 days in cold storage for audits
Authentication: Console rollup API will honor org-level KMS settings for private deployments; security review not required for initial MVP
